svg.title: P24: Guardian approval reviewer collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Primitive · A² A2 · guard role collaboration
A proposed tool action is classified as requiring
Policy requests approval or an automated reviewer
Review request, reviewer context, decision reason,
The action waits for and executes only after an
Proposed action identity, risk context, and
The approval binds to the exact action and
pending or accept a different action.
blocks execution with a typed outcome.
1 propose(action) → 2 review(action) → 3 assess(action) → 4 verdict(decision) → 5 approve(action) → 6 return(result) → 7
Evidence: 23/41 repositories, 22/36 families; 23 trajectories (14 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Human prompt, reviewer agent, policy guardian, callback, and resumable interruption.
Negative control: A post-hoc warning after execution is not an approval gate.
